remarks: Prime 850 SF Downtown Retail Space - 2 MAIN Street, Norwalk, CT  Position your business in a high-visibility retail location in the heart of downtown Norwalk! This beautifully updated 850 SF storefront offers a bright, clean, modern aesthetic with hardwood-style flooring, high ceilings, and central gas heat & air conditioning-creating an inviting space for your customers and team.  Key Features & Highlights:  Space: ~850 SF storefront with flexible open layout.  Condition: Turnkey interior with updated flooring, high ceilings, and central HVAC.  Location: Directly on Wall Street near the head of Norwalk Harbor, Norwalk Green, and Wall Street Theater.  Foot Traffic: Vibrant commercial district surrounded by popular dining, arts, and local retail.  Accessibility: Easy access to I-95, Route 7, and public transit options.  Ideal For: Boutique retail, specialty market/gourmet shop, service establishment, salon, or professional storefront.
